record.what_it_does: Xero is cloud accounting software, and its API lets third-party apps read and write a connected organisation's accounting data (invoices, contacts, bank transactions, payments, reports) plus payroll, assets, projects, and files.
record.auth_notes: Standard multi-tenant apps use the OAuth2 authorization code flow or its PKCE extension. A separate paid add-on called Custom Connections uses the OAuth2 client credentials grant for single-organisation, non-interactive integrations ($10/mo per connection).
record.access_notes: Sign-up is free and every account gets a fully functional Demo Company for building/testing at no cost, with client ID/secret issued immediately. However the free 'Starter' tier caps an app at 5 live organisation connections; scaling beyond that requires a paid connections tier or, for App Store distribution, Xero's certification/review process.
record.main_blocker: Free/Starter tier caps live connections at 5; broader multi-customer distribution needs a paid connections tier or Xero App Store certification review
